description: Code, stored results and analysis scripts for the paper "From Regime Shift to Redundancy: Boundary Conditions for Swarm-Based Feature Selection". The code extends Orthogonal Particle Swarm Optimisation with Crossover (OrPSOC) to non-stationary data with self-triggered and detector-triggered adaptation, and evaluates it against an all-features baseline, other swarm selectors (correlation-guided PSO, Taguchi chaotic binary PSO, hybrid PSO/differential evolution, binary whale optimisation) and filter or embedded selectors (mRMR, LASSO, RFE) under one walk-forward cross-validation protocol. It covers a synthetic benchmark with known signal features, financial datasets built from public sources, a dimensionality ladder and synthetic width sweep, a nested cross-validation analysis of the regularisation penalty, regime-change detector comparisons and two non-financial benchmarks. Most tables and figures regenerate in about a minute from the stored results in the repository. The merged real ladder, Table 8a (synthetic k-NN panel), Fig. S4 and the raw outputs behind Table S13 need the checkpoint archives deposited with this record (one script, scripts/rebuild_from_deposit.sh, unpacks them and re-renders everything); the original units behind Table 8a's synthetic panel were lost, and the deposited ones are a recomputation that reproduces it exactly. Table S5 needs the datasets. The datasets are not redistributed: they are rebuilt from public sources that revise their history, so a fresh download need not reproduce the stored values bit for bit, and RFE is not numerically portable across platforms or data downloads. The README records where each result was computed and which were not re-run on the canonical data copy (Table S6).
